_comment: DRAFT for OA's signature (OA-496); not committed until OA signs.

eg_cq01h.why: u_map's table, read a stage before G-1's write lands (OA-496, OI-215): u_map writes G-1's names at the parent's 04 (m_*_cq04h), and u_dep reads the entries at 03, never the cycle they are written; the hits the read cannot yet see are G-1's, which prv_dep carries (prv_carries_g1), and G-2's, which the declared G-2 bypass carries.
